_family_prefixes_note: Section-number prefix of each verbatim statute, used by classify_citation. A cited base section matching a prefix but absent from that statute's section list is 'fabricated' (e.g. 20-875); matching no prefix is 'unverified' (DCWP 5-3xx, TX 551.x).

_provenance_notes.co_aia: Verbatim from 2024a_205_signed-act.pdf (26pp enacted SB 24-205). Sections 6-1-1701..6-1-1707 confirmed present in the PDF (incl. 6-1-1705 and 6-1-1707). NOTE: the co_aia_sb24_205.txt study-aid OMITS 6-1-1705 and 6-1-1707 and adds interpretive annotations; it is NOT used to build this index.
_provenance_notes.nyc_ll144: Verbatim from 'Legislation Text.pdf' (4pp, Int. 1894-A). Real sections: 20-870 (Definitions), 20-871 (Requirements; subdivisions a, b), 20-872 (Penalties; a-d), 20-873 (Enforcement), 20-874 (Construction). There is NO 20-875. NOTE: the nyc_ll144_statute.txt study-aid fabricates a 20-875, mislabels 20-873/20-874, and invents a 20-871(d); it is NOT used. Marked 'statute-only' because NYC citations also reference the DCWP Final Rules (6 RCNY 5-3xx), a separate source that is MISSING.
_provenance_notes.nyc_dcwp_rules: 6 RCNY 5-300 et seq. NOT in corpus as authoritative text. Teacher/students cite 5-300/5-301/5-302/5-303. The nyc_ll144_dcwp_rules.txt file is an unverified study-aid (not an authoritative DCWP extract) and is NOT used. Source the adopted DCWP rules to populate.
_provenance_notes.tx_traiga: No authoritative TX text in corpus. 89RDAY81FINAL.pdf is a HOUSE JOURNAL (floor proceedings/roll call for the 81st day), NOT the HB 149 enrolled statute. tx_traiga_hb149.txt is an AI-generated summary with comparative cross-state annotations and a non-contiguous section list (551.001/051/101/102/201/301) that almost certainly omits real sections. Both unusable; source the HB 149 enrolled text to populate.
